description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of categories within a dataset, displaying the proportion of different categories present. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories are labeled as "chat" (red, 41.2%), "math" (blue, 21.9%), "tooluse" (green, 11.6%), "multi turn chat" (orange, 9.3%), "code" (purple, 9.0%), and "instruction follow" (pink, 6.9%). The percentage labels are displayed outside the corresponding slices. A legend is provided in the top-left corner, correlating the colors with their respective categories and providing the count for each category. The slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with the largest slice ("chat") positioned at the top-left and the smallest slice ("instruction follow") at the top-right.
